method.paired: immutable/Automatic per repeat, median of five ratios
method.clock_precision: published nine-decimal core/Bevy clocks, not raw f64 equality

provenance.source_scope: supplied frozen prebuild snapshot; not current-worktree attribution

strict_feature_clippy.scope_basis: root-invoked strict feature-enabled command; successful log

default_simd_identity.scope: same original private diagnostic kernel before/after const-generic refactor; not all graph code or end-to-end frame equivalence

gpu_summary.dynamic_scope: numeric Rotation6, size/color, asymmetric2x2 atlas/alpha, lifetime
gpu_summary.graphics_scope: bounded arithmetic, not bit-perfect native game rendering

lich_changed_row_replay.scope: untimed upload/fidelity proof; debug frame times are not performance results

final_native_corpus.scope: Interpreter versus Automatic using the final typed-packet core; all three evolution modes; source/binary/asset hashes in raw manifest; correctness only, no timing claim

limitations: Original synthetic workload; no cross-engine or native-game fidelity claim
I32 amplifies effect cost; I1 also reported; no fixed-Bevy-cost compensation
Wall/step/wait quantiles independent; not GPU timestamps or pipelined throughput
Before transfers include residency/capture/warmup; not isolated cold-time measurements
Transfers exclude textures/meshes/unrelated Bevy buffers; mapped initialization kept separate
Ratios above1retain regressions; no speedup or statistical significance presumed
